extraction_notes: The forward-voltage table row is a maximum value for the M1F through M7F family at IF = 1 A; the plotted curve is a typical family characteristic.
IR1 is 2 microA at the rated DC blocking voltage and Ta = 25 degC; the separate 200 microA Ta = 125 degC row was not used.
No reverse-recovery time is published in the supplied datasheet.
The Fig. 3 curve was digitized from the supplied vector plot path without interpolation between table values.
